title: LEYO puts a modern spin on Filipino harana in new EP
summary: Filipino singer-songwriter LEYO explores the traditions of Filipino courtship music in “Akda sa Pag-alala,” a six-track EP that blends classic OPM, acoustic pop and R&B.
